_comment: Version history. Prose detail in wiki/08-changelog.md; root causes in wiki/09-defects-and-lessons.md. current = 1.13.0.

versions.theme: Foundation: 4 tools, atomic persistence, leniency, single response builder, enforced approval gate, APPROVAL_NOT_REQUESTED, air-gap packaging.
Blocking approval — physically pause the agent loop via a held tool call + localhost page + heartbeat timeout arithmetic.
Stale approval fix: approval TTL expiry + new goal does not inherit an approval.
Approval request outlives the tool call; late click applied on next call.
Concurrency round 1: cross-process file lock; release lock during human wait; threaded stdio loop.
One approval surface per state dir: shared approval.json + singleton page with takeover.
Multi-plan: plans coexist, routed by id/goal/only-active; approval queue.
Edge-case hunt (4 commits): thread-safe transaction, file-lock timeout, SSE fixes, failure-path honesty, leniency safety, approval-page browser verification.

Goal-drift routing: continuing (step>1) with an unmatched goal returns the active-goal list to pick from instead of forking a plan; plan_and_think accepts plan_id; goal matching ignores trailing punctuation.

Task completion enforced: DONE requires a prior IN_PROGRESS, in-order completion, and content-checked result_log evidence; the last DONE enters AWAITING_COMPLETION where a human verifies a per-task completion report before COMPLETED.

Per-task plan review: the approval page collects a comment per task on a PLAN request, and REVISE with scope=TASKS rewrites only the flagged tasks via plan_and_think's new task_updates parameter - ids, positions and untouched evidence survive. The completion phase is deliberately excluded and stays whole-plan.

Call-count reduction without weakening enforcement: auto_advance starts the next task as part of accepting a DONE (5 tasks = 6 execution calls, was 10), the tool description follows the mode via build_tool_definitions, a redundant IN_PROGRESS is idempotent, and task_updates sent without a task_id is paired with the single flagged task instead of dropped. Rejected from the same review: batch DONE marking, and merging task_list with task_updates.

Mutable goal: plan_and_think takes revised_goal, which updates the plan's goal in place (same plan_id and tasks) and keeps original_goal + goal_history as the audit anchor. A plan still answers to its former goal text, so a model one turn behind a correction does not lose its plan; a punctuation-only 'revision' is not recorded; a revision on an approved plan is taken but explicitly does not extend the approval. Drift protection had hardened into an inability to be corrected.

Observed in use: the model finished every task and then answered the user instead of requesting the completion report, so the HITL completion gate silently never ran. Since auto-advance, message carried the next-step order on every mid-loop DONE, so the last DONE - where nothing can be auto-started - was the one response that said nothing, and the silence read as 'no further orders'. _finish_task now always states the next step, and the empty-advanced case splits three ways (work left / AWAITING_COMPLETION -> ask for the completion report / COMPLETED -> write the final answer) because 'nothing was advanced' is not the same as 'the plan is finished' when auto_advance is off. The agent prompt now names message as an instruction channel in R4/R7. next_action is untouched.

Reported from the field: the plan/approve/execute/report/approve loop is fine on a small model, but pressing 수정 요청 on the COMPLETION report made it useless. Not the model - a completion revision was always a whole-plan redraft, which left the plan DRAFTING with every task DONE, gave the generic re-plan hint with the human's sentence in no instruction field, and then deleted every result_log because finalizing replaces plan.tasks. Now AWAITING_COMPLETION + per-task comments means REWORK: only the named tasks reopen (revision_note set, previous_result_log kept), every other task keeps DONE and its evidence, and the plan returns to IN_EXECUTION with no re-approval since the task list did not change. The hint leads with the human's own words and _rework_suffix repeats them wherever a task is handed over. The whole-plan escape hatch survives for add/delete/reorder and now carries evidence across the redraft via _carry_evidence + title_key. Closes a second-order hole: an all-done approval now routes to AWAITING_COMPLETION instead of unlocking a plan with nothing to run.
